moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last long weekend of summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland arrives, with many making plans for travel and events.

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: August Bank Holiday weekend is almost here! Expect busy roads and some rail disruptions, especially around London King's Cross. Plan ahead!

angles.name: Last Taste of Summer
angles.copy: Your final chance for a long weekend lie-in before autumn truly kicks in! How are you spending the August Bank Holiday?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Kick Off
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals return this Bank Holiday weekend, August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds kicks off this Thursday! Who are you most excited to see? Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. – it's a huge line-up!

angles.name: Rock & Pop Weekend
angles.copy: From rock anthems to chart-topping pop, Reading & Leeds has it all this weekend. Get ready for some massive live sets!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Weekend
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's leading electronic dance music festivals, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire from August 27-30 with Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, and Martin Garrix.

angles.name: Dance Nation Unite
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Get ready for four days of non-stop beats from Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Martin Garrix and more. Who's heading to Daresbury?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend means one thing for dance fans: Creamfields! Gates open Thursday for a massive electronic music celebration.

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 2 Continues
moments.blurb: The second weekend of the Premier League season features Crystal Palace v Manchester City on Friday, Spurs v Newcastle on Saturday, and Aston Villa v Arsenal on Monday.

angles.name: Football Friday
angles.copy: Premier League Matchweek 2 kicks off Friday night with Crystal Palace hosting Manchester City. Who's taking the points?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Football
angles.copy: Spurs v Newcastle on Saturday, Aston Villa v Arsenal on Bank Holiday Monday! This weekend's Premier League action is unmissable.

moments.title: Happy 77th Birthday, Gene Simmons!
moments.blurb: KISS co-founder, bassist, and co-lead vocalist Gene Simmons, known as 'The Demon', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Demon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Demon, Gene Simmons of KISS! What's your favourite KISS track to crank up?

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: The man behind the makeup, Gene Simmons, turns 77 today. A true rock icon!

moments.title: Happy 72nd Birthday, Elvis Costello!
moments.blurb: Influential British singer-songwriter Elvis Costello, known for hits like 'Oliver's Army' and 'Pump It Up', celebrates his 72nd birthday today.

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the brilliant Elvis Costello! Which of his classic tracks is on your playlist today?

angles.name: Songwriter's Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring artistry of Elvis Costello on his 72nd birthday. A true master of lyrics and melody.

moments.title: Happy 75th Birthday, Rob Halford!
moments.blurb: The 'Metal God' himself, Judas Priest frontman Rob Halford, known for his powerful vocals and iconic stage presence, turns 75 today.

angles.name: Metal God's Day
angles.copy: Raise your horns! Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Rob Halford from Judas Priest!

angles.name: Judas Priest Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible vocal talent and influence of Rob Halford on his 75th birthday. What's your favourite Judas Priest song?

moments.title: Happy 60th Birthday, Shirley Manson!
moments.blurb: Scottish singer and Garbage frontwoman Shirley Manson, known for her distinctive vocals and fierce stage persona, celebrates her 60th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Garbage Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 60th Birthday to the iconic Shirley Manson of Garbage tomorrow! Still rocking as hard as ever.

angles.name: 90s Alt-Rock Star
angles.copy: Shirley Manson turns 60 tomorrow! What's your favourite track from Garbage?

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Shania Twain!
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Country Pop' Shania Twain, known for global hits like 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' and 'That Don't Impress Me Much', celebrates her 61st birthday on August 28.

angles.name: Country Pop Queen
angles.copy: Man! She feels like a woman, and she's turning 61! Happy Birthday to the incredible Shania Twain on August 28th!

angles.name: Still the One
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Shania Twain as she turns 61. What's your go-to Shania anthem?

moments.title: Happy 40th Birthday, Florence Welch!
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the captivating frontwoman of Florence + The Machine, known for her powerful vocals and ethereal style, turns 40 on August 28.

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the magnificent Florence Welch of Florence + The Machine on August 28th! What's your favourite track from her?

angles.name: Big Voice Big Day
angles.copy: The incredibly talented Florence Welch celebrates her 40th this week! Send her some birthday love.

moments.title: Happy 40th Birthday, Ryan Ross!
moments.blurb: Former Panic! At The Disco guitarist and lyricist Ryan Ross, a key figure in their early sound, celebrates his 40th birthday on August 30.

angles.name: Panic! Legend
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to Ryan Ross, formerly of Panic! At The Disco, on August 30th! What's your favourite early P!ATD track?

angles.name: Emo Icon Turns 40
angles.copy: Celebrating Ryan Ross's 40th this weekend! His songwriting shaped a generation of alternative music.

moments.title: Happy 69th Birthday, Gloria Estefan!
moments.blurb: Cuban-American singer Gloria Estefan, known for her Latin pop fusion with Miami Sound Machine and her solo career, turns 69 on September 1.

angles.name: Conga Queen
angles.copy: Get On Your Feet! Happy 69th Birthday to the incredible Gloria Estefan on September 1st! What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Latin Pop Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the timeless music of Gloria Estefan as she turns 69. A true icon!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 24, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Is Back
angles.copy: Get your spatulas ready! The Great British Bake Off returns to Channel 4 on September 24th, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood in the tent!

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent? Yes please! The new series starts September 24th. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Show
moments.blurb: The pre-recorded launch show for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is expected to air on BBC One on Saturday, September 19, revealing the celebrity-pro pairings.

angles.name: Strictly Is Back!
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! The Strictly Come Dancing launch show is expected to hit our screens September 19th! Who are you hoping to see paired up?

angles.name: New Hosts, New Season
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take the helm for Strictly 2026! Catch the launch show September 19th.

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Top 40 Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Official Singles Chart Number 1 spot for an impressive 22nd week.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: 22 WEEKS AT NUMBER 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still dominating the Official Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Can anyone stop them?

angles.name: New Music & Movers
angles.copy: Beyond the top spot, the Official Singles Chart is buzzing with new entries and big movers this week! What's your favourite new track?

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Beyoncé!
moments.blurb: Global superstar and cultural icon Beyoncé, known for her groundbreaking music and performances, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! The legendary Beyoncé turns 45 on September 4th. What's your ultimate Beyoncé anthem?

angles.name: Icon Turns 45
angles.copy: Celebrating the one and only Beyoncé as she approaches her 45th birthday. Her influence is undeniable!
